name: [🌋UPD] +1 double jump for Brainrots!
desc:
Welcome to +1 Double Jump for Brainrots! 🚀🧠

Jump higher, go farther, and collect as many Brainrots as you can! Use your growing double jumps to reach insane heights and discover new areas! 🌌

How to play:
🦘 Double jump your way across each area
🧠 Collect Brainrots to earn Cash
⚡ Gain +1 Double Jump every time you progress
💵 Upgrade your Brainrots to boost your income
🏗️ Expand your base to unlock more storage slots
🌍 Explore higher zones with stronger jumps

Be careful not to fall… or you’ll have to try again! 😱

💤 Your Brainrots generate Cash even while OFFLINE!

Rebirth to multiply your cash! ♻️

👍 Like the game and join the group for FREE OP Brainrots!
